description: This header file declares the interface for the MultiLAN SBAPI functions related to data model integration in the Cisco platform. It includes function prototypes for initialization, cleanup, and retrieval of various network configuration parameters.

methods.name: CosaDmlMlanInit
methods.description: Initializes the MultiLAN data model with provided handles.

methods.name: CosaDmlMlanUnload
methods.description: Unloads or cleans up the MultiLAN data model context.

methods.name: CosaDmlMlanGetPrimaryLanIpIf
methods.description: Retrieves the primary LAN IP interface.

methods.name: CosaDmlMlanGetHomeSecurityIpIf
methods.description: Retrieves the home security IP interface.

methods.name: CosaDmlMlanGetPrimaryLanBridge
methods.description: Gets the primary LAN bridge configuration.

methods.name: CosaDmlMlanGetPrimaryLanBridgeHsPorts
methods.description: Gets the home security ports for the primary LAN bridge.

methods.name: CosaDmlMlanGetPrimaryLanDhcpv4ServerPool
methods.description: Retrieves the DHCPv4 server pool for the primary LAN.

methods.name: CosaDmlMlanGetHomeSecurityBridge
methods.description: Gets the home security bridge configuration.

methods.name: CosaDmlMlanGetHomeSecurityBridgePorts
methods.description: Retrieves the ports associated with the home security bridge.

methods.name: CosaDmlMlanGetHomeSecurityDhcpv4ServerPool
methods.description: Retrieves the DHCPv4 server pool for home security.

methods.name: CosaDmlMlanGetHomeSecurityWiFiRadio
methods.description: Gets WiFi radio configuration for home security.

methods.name: CosaDmlMlanGetHomeSecurityWiFiSsid
methods.description: Gets the WiFi SSID for home security.

methods.name: CosaDmlMlanGetHomeSecurityWiFiAp
methods.description: Gets WiFi access point configuration for home security.
